points.title: 我, 你, 您: people words and greetings
points.summary: Lets you say I, you, he, she and we (adding 们 for more than one person) and greet people politely with 你好 and 您好.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u01-l1|Saying hello: 你好 and 您好

points.title: 是: A is B
points.summary: Lets you link two nouns to say who or what someone or something is, as in 我是学生.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u01-l2|是 sentences: A 是 B

points.title: 吗: yes-no questions
points.summary: Lets you turn any statement into a yes-no question by adding 吗 at the end, as in 你是老师吗？

points.title: 呢: and you?
points.summary: Lets you bounce a question back or ask about someone else with a short phrase like 你呢？

points.title: 谁, 什么, 哪: who, what, which
points.summary: Lets you ask who, what and which by putting the question word where the answer will go, as in 他是谁？

points.title: 不: not
points.summary: Lets you say no or not by putting 不 before a verb or adjective, as in 我不是老师 and 我不忙.

points.title: Numbers and 第: counting and first, second
points.summary: Lets you count, read phone and room numbers digit by digit, and say first, second, third with 第.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u02-l1|Counting and reading numbers digit by digit

points.title: 个, 本, 件: counting words
points.summary: Lets you count people and things with a number + counting word + noun, as in 三个人 and 两本书.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u02-l2|Counting people and things with 个
hsk1-u05-l2|Measure words 本 and 件

points.title: 几 and 多少: how many, how old, how much
points.summary: Lets you ask about numbers, someone's age and prices with 几, 多大 and 多少钱.

points.title: Dates and clock time: 月, 号, 星期, 点
points.summary: Lets you say and ask the date, the day of the week and the time, as in 五月八号, 星期几 and 三点半.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u02-l4|Dates: X月X号 and 星期几
hsk1-u06-l1|Telling time: X点Y分 and X点半

points.title: 的: my, your, his
points.summary: Lets you show who something belongs to by putting 的 between the owner and the thing, as in 我的书.

points.title: 有 / 没有: have, there is
points.summary: Lets you say what someone has or doesn't have, and what there is in a place.

points.title: 这, 那, 哪 (+些): this, that, which
points.summary: Lets you point to things near and far, one or many, and ask which one, as in 这个, 那些 and 哪些.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u03-l3|这 and 那: this / that
hsk1-u05-l3|这些 / 那些 / 哪些: these, those, which

points.title: 和, 也, 都: and, also, all
points.summary: Lets you join two nouns with 和 and say also and all with 也 and 都, which come before the verb.

points.title: 很 + adjective: describing people and things
points.summary: Lets you describe someone or something with an adjective, usually with 很 and no 是, as in 她很高.

points.title: A不A: yes-or-no with two options
points.summary: Lets you ask a yes-no question by saying the verb twice with 不 in between, as in 你去不去？

points.title: Word order: who + when + where + do what
points.summary: Lets you build sentences in the right order: subject, then time, then place, then verb and object.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u06-l2|Time words go before the verb

points.title: 想 / 要 + verb: want to
points.summary: Lets you say what you want or would like to do, as in 我想喝茶.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u04-l2|想 / 要 + verb: want to

points.title: 太…了: too, so
points.summary: Lets you say something is too much or react strongly, as in 太贵了 and 太好了！

points.title: 在 + place + verb: doing something somewhere
points.summary: Lets you say where an action happens by putting 在 + place before the verb, as in 我在家吃饭.

points.title: 吧: let's, suggestions
points.summary: Lets you make suggestions and soft requests by adding 吧, as in 我们走吧.

points.title: 可以: may, can (permission)
points.summary: Lets you ask for and give permission, as in 我可以坐这儿吗？

points.title: …的时候: when …
points.summary: Lets you say when something happens by adding 的时候 after an action, as in 吃饭的时候.

points.title: 正在 / 在 + verb: doing right now
points.summary: Lets you say an action is happening right now, as in 他正在看书.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u06-l4|正在 + verb: action in progress

points.title: 去 / 来 + place: go, come
points.summary: Lets you say where someone goes or comes, as in 我去学校, and use handy words like 上学.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u07-l1|Using 上学 (to go to school)

points.title: 会 + verb: can (a learned skill)
points.summary: Lets you say what you know how to do, as in 我会说汉语.

points.title: 了: completed actions
points.summary: Lets you say an action has happened or is done, as in 我买了一本书.

points.title: 没(有): didn't, haven't
points.summary: Lets you say something did not happen, using 没 or 没有 before the verb and dropping 了, as in 我没去.

points.title: 给 + person + verb: for / to someone
points.summary: Lets you say who an action is done for or to, as in 我给妈妈打电话.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u07-l5|给 + person + verb: doing something for or to someone

points.title: 在哪儿 and 上, 里: where things are
points.summary: Lets you ask and say where something is, using words like 上 and 里 after a noun, as in 书在桌子上.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u08-l2|Location words: 桌子上, 房间里

points.title: 怎么 / 怎么样: how
points.summary: Lets you ask how to do something and how something is, as in 怎么去？ and 怎么样？

points.title: 了: change (now it's…)
points.summary: Lets you say a situation has changed by adding 了 at the end, as in 天冷了.

points.title: 有点儿 + adjective: a bit (too)
points.summary: Lets you say something is a bit too much, usually in a negative way, as in 有点儿贵.

points.title: 不要 + verb: don't
points.summary: Lets you tell someone not to do something, as in 不要说话.

points.title: 喜欢 + verb: like doing
points.summary: Lets you say what you like or like doing, as in 我喜欢看书.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u10-l1|喜欢 + verb: liking to do something

points.title: 看见 / 听见: see, hear
points.summary: Lets you say you actually saw or heard something by adding 见 after 看 or 听.
lesson_notes: hsk1-u10-l2|见 after a verb: actually seeing or hearing

points.title: 有的…有的…: some … others …
points.summary: Lets you split a group into parts, as in 有的人喝茶，有的人喝咖啡.

points.title: 百, 千, 万 and 两 vs 二: big numbers
points.summary: Lets you say big numbers and choose correctly between 两 and 二.

points.title: 还是: A or B?
points.summary: Lets you ask someone to choose between two options, as in 你喝茶还是喝咖啡？

points.title: 多 + adjective: how tall, how long
points.summary: Lets you ask about size, distance and age with 多, as in 你多高？ and 有多远？

points.title: 的: describing nouns
points.summary: Lets you describe a noun with an adjective or an action before 的, as in 很好的朋友 and 我买的书.

points.title: 还: still, also
points.summary: Lets you say something is still the case or add more, as in 他还在睡觉 and 我还想买一个.

points.title: 看看, 试试: doing something a little
points.summary: Lets you make an action sound short and relaxed by saying the verb twice, as in 我看看.

points.title: 一点儿 vs 有点儿: a little
points.summary: Lets you say a little more or less with 一点儿 after an adjective, as in 便宜一点儿, and tell it apart from 有点儿.

points.title: 能: can (able to), vs 会 and 可以
points.summary: Lets you say you are able to do something and choose between 能, 会 and 可以.

points.title: 别: don't
points.summary: Lets you tell someone not to do something in a short, friendly way, as in 别走.

points.title: 跟…一起: together with
points.summary: Lets you say who you do something with, as in 我跟朋友一起吃饭.

points.title: 对: to, towards
points.summary: Lets you say who an attitude or action is aimed at, as in 他对我很好.

points.title: 给, 送, 教 + person + thing
points.summary: Lets you say who gets what, as in 我送他一本书.

points.title: 从…到…: from … to …
points.summary: Lets you give starting and ending points in time and place, as in 从八点到十点.

points.title: 离: distance from
points.summary: Lets you say how near or far one place is from another, as in 我家离学校很近.

points.title: 过: have done before
points.summary: Lets you talk about things you have or haven't experienced, as in 我去过中国.

points.title: 次, 遍: how many times
points.summary: Lets you say how many times you do something, as in 我去过两次.

points.title: 还没(有)…呢: not yet
points.summary: Lets you say something hasn't happened yet, as in 我还没吃饭呢.

points.title: Verb + time length: for how long
points.summary: Lets you say how long an action lasts, as in 我学了两年汉语.

points.title: 是…的: when, where, how it happened
points.summary: Lets you focus on when, where or how a past action happened, as in 我是坐飞机来的.

points.title: 着: an ongoing state
points.summary: Lets you describe a state that continues, as in 门开着 and 他穿着红衣服.

points.title: 啊 and 呢: softer, livelier tone
points.summary: Lets you sound warmer and more natural with 啊, and stress something is happening now with 呢.

points.title: 快要…了: about to
points.summary: Lets you say something is going to happen very soon, as in 快要下雨了.

points.title: 先…然后…: first … then …
points.summary: Lets you put actions in order, as in 我先吃饭，然后去学校.

points.title: 再 / 又: again
points.summary: Lets you say again about the future with 再 and about the past with 又, as in 明天再来 and 他又来了.

points.title: 就 / 才: early or late, easy or hard
points.summary: Lets you show something happened sooner or later than expected, as in 他七点就来了 and 他十点才来.

points.title: 比: A is more … than B
points.summary: Lets you compare two things, as in 今天比昨天冷.

points.title: 跟…一样: the same as
points.summary: Lets you say two things are the same, as in 我跟他一样高.

points.title: 没有…那么: not as … as
points.summary: Lets you say one thing is not as good, big or fast as another, as in 我没有他那么高.

points.title: 最: the most
points.summary: Lets you say something is the best, biggest or most, as in 他最高.

points.title: 完, 好, 到, 懂, 错: result after a verb
points.summary: Lets you say what result an action had, as in 吃完了, 听懂了 and 写错了.

points.title: 进来, 出去, 回来: direction after a verb
points.summary: Lets you show which way a movement goes, as in 他走进来了.

points.title: 得: how well you do something
points.summary: Lets you say how well or how fast someone does something, as in 他说得很好.

points.title: 因为…所以…: because … so …
points.summary: Lets you give reasons and results, as in 因为下雨，所以我没去, and answer 为什么.

points.title: 虽然…但是…: although … but …
points.summary: Lets you contrast two ideas, as in 虽然很贵，但是很好.

points.title: 一边…一边…: while doing
points.summary: Lets you say someone does two things at the same time, as in 他一边吃饭一边看电视.
